name: Unibic Choco Chip Cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Chocolate Chips (21%) [Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Butter, Dextrose, Emulsifiers (INS 322 from Soy, INS 476)], Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm), Desiccated Coconut, Butter, Milk Solids, Leavening Agents (INS 503 i INS 500 i), Emulsifier (INS 322 from Soy), lodised Salt, Artificial Flavouring Substance (Vanillin). Allergen Advice: Contains Wheat, Milk and Soy. May contain traces of Nut.
